review_protocol: One AI reviewer inspected all 50 selected frames in contact sheets plus full-resolution source examples before observing predictor outputs. Not independent human annotation. Frame coordinates apply to the normalized 25 fps, 50-frame grayscale samples.

mma.rationale: Rock/vegetation detail remains visible throughout; moving water is not itself defocus. Letterbox bars are part of the source and are not a whole-frame exposure defect. Title animation is excluded by the predeclared 10-second selection.

flow.rationale: Grass/rock edges remain visible across the sample. Water/specular motion and source compression are not labeled focus failure. Scene is visibly lit; this does not label every highlight or local shadow as acceptable exposure.

mist.rationale: Atmospheric haze and background softness cannot be reliably separated from optical focus error by this review. Do not convert that uncertainty to a defect or a normal-focus judgment. Foreground/terrain remain visible; no global underexposure is apparent.

blur.operator: gblur sigma=6 on normalized frames 15..34 inclusive
blur.rationale: Known synthetic blur interval, visually checked after generation; not an actual camera focus failure. Outside that interval inherit the original label, including unknown haze.

dark.operator: lutyuv y=val*0.04 on normalized frames 15..34 inclusive
dark.rationale: Known synthetic darkening interval, visually checked after generation; not a natural camera exposure failure. Outside that interval inherit the original label.
